result.artifact:
SELECT month, region, total_sales FROM (
  SELECT
    substr(ordered_at,1,7) AS month,
    region,
    SUM(amount) AS total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY substr(ordered_at,1,7) ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY substr(ordered_at,1,7), region
) WHERE rnk <= 2;
